steps.content:
10:30, July 23, N.F. 113
Shalom's Home, Erica Villa, Eastside
It was a dreamless night. A soft floral scent wakes Rahu from her sleep.
She opens her eyes and sees the woman close by, fiddling with the flowers beside the headboard. She removes some bandages and wraps the wound up again with new ones.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...How are you feeling? You were drenched in rain last night, and... I can't recall, did I attack you last night?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: I'm fine. Your injuries are worse.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You were unconscious the whole night after we came back. They're all worried something bad happened to the FAC elite.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm fine. I just slept hard.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Get up then if you feel better.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You came all guns blazing yesterday. Don't tell me you wanna slack off now?
Rahu doesn't get up right away. She slumps into the warm bed and spends a moment separating reality from dream.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Nothing, I'm only a little surprised.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I feel like I hadn't slept so soundly in a long time...
Shalom smiles. She draws the curtains open and sunlight instantly fills the bedroom.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Don't sleep in. Time waits for no one. Come on, we've got important things to do.
